name: Toshihiro Ogura
biography: Toshihiro Ogura (おぐら としひろ Ogura Toshihiro) is a Japanese suit actor. A prolific suit actor with an illustrious career in tokusatsu, Ogura is best known as a recurring suit actor in Toei's popular Kamen Rider and Super Sentai franchises. Characterized by his relatively petite body size, Ogura is recognized for his ability to make use of his entire body in his performances for both action and comical roles. Ogura was one of many suit actors frequently employed by Toei to act in Toho's Godzilla: Final Wars, in which he portrayed three different kaiju.
